      4 out of 5 stars
      Healthy Frying Made Easy, with a Few Small Improvements Needed
      Reviewed in India on 12 February 2024
      Pattern Name: Air Fryer with Touch Panel
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      The Philips Digital Air Fryer HD9252/90 does a wonderful job of making healthier versions of fried foods. It's easy to use, produces tasty results, and has definitely changed the way I snack! Here's why it didn't quite earn a perfect five stars from me:

      Pros:

      Delicious and Guilt-Free: Foods come out crispy with minimal oil, offering a healthier alternative to deep frying.

      User-Friendly: Clear touchscreen controls and the preset cooking programs make operation a breeze.

      Good Capacity: The 4.1L size is perfect for cooking for my family of three, or preparing snacks for a small gathering.

      Easy Cleanup: The removable basket and parts are dishwasher safe.

      Cons:

      Can be noisy: The fan creates a noticeable hum when in use.

      Pricey: This model sits on the higher end of the air fryer price range.

      Overall: If you're serious about eating healthier without sacrificing flavor, I highly recommend the Philips Digital Air Fryer HD9252/90. The few minor gripes aside, it is a fantastic tool. If the price isn't a deterrent and you can live without a few convenience features, you won't be disappointed.

    • manish
      5 out of 5 stars
      Great choice for low fat cooking
      Reviewed in India on 10 September 2024
      Pattern Name: Air Fryer with Touch Panel
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Haven't been able to make too many dishes till now, but thats because i am not much of a cook and my wife isn't comfortable around new gadgets, sadly. But whatever we were able to manage (mostly morning/evening snacks), it was great. It requires a little getting used to, the online recepies don't work as is and need a little tweaking. And if you have a few bad batches, (which you most certainly will in the beginning), it feels like a total waste of money. But once you get a hang of it, you will start loving it. Plus benefit of eating much less oil will want you to eat worryfree and more.

      The operation is pretty straightforward, select a preset menu or set temperature and time. Its as simple as that. Cooks really fast and with just a sprinkle of oil.

      This model has decent capacity and power for my use. The baskets are dishwasher friendly, which is a big benefit for me. It makes the cleaning hassel free.

      There is no additional accessory included in package which is a little disappointment. There are other airfryers with much less price that provide same value, so the higher price just for the brand name is a little excessive.

      Overall its a great product, just needs a little patience for first time users.

    Product description

    Philips Airfryer’s unique “starfish” design, swirls hot air to evenly fry without having to flip the food in the basket. Create crispy and juicy food with no flipping and no peeping!
